patterns.message: SY32: use requireMembership() + tenantDb(organizationId) from '@/lib/tenant'. Raw db bypasses tenant scoping; only lib/tenant.ts, lib/platform/**, scripts/**, prisma/** may import it. Machine contexts resolve the company via lib/platform/resolve.ts first.

no-restricted-syntax.message: SY25: raw hex colours are not allowed in components. Use a token from packages/tokens (Tailwind: bg-syncit-bond, text-syncit-ink, …; mobile: theme.colors.<name>) or add a new token to tokens.json and regenerate.
